canonical_title: Brad Lightcap leaves OpenAI for a new venture
treatment: Repeat only if the new venture is identified, the departure materially changes OpenAI leadership/operations, or OpenAI announces a consequential replacement or reorganization.
known_facts: Senior OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap said he will leave to start a new venture.
Lightcap had moved from COO to special projects in April and OpenAI said day-to-day team operations are not expected to be affected.
reinclude_only_if: Lightcap discloses the new venture and it has material AI relevance.
OpenAI announces a consequential leadership or organizational change tied to the departure.
notes: Corporate delta; lower technical significance than the NVIDIA model items.
